(Nasdaq: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that it has entered into an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association (JPMorgan) for $100 million of its common stock, as part of its previously announced $200 million share repurchase authorization.

items.title: The Estée Lauder Companies Holds Annual Meeting of Stockholders
items.summary: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) (“the Company”) held its Annual Meeting of Stockholders today. William P. Lauder, Chair of the Board of Directors, chaired the meeting. At the meeting, stockholders elected Stéphane de La Faverie, Jean-Frédéric Dufour, Gary M. Lauder, Jane Lauder and Matthew E. Rubel to the Board as Class III Directors. Stockholders also ratified the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as independent auditors for the current fiscal year
